title: viRusneRd5/cmvresistancefinder pipeline parameters
description: Identifies cytomegalovirus (CMV) antiviral resistant mutations from short- and long-read sequencing data.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: For read input (--input_type short-read or long-read) the samplesheet is validated against assets/schema_input.json (columns: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2); for --input_type fasta against assets/schema_input_fasta.json (columns: sample, fasta).

input_type.description: Type of input: 'short-read' (Illumina reads), 'long-read' (Oxford Nanopore reads), or 'fasta' (Sanger / assembled per-gene consensus sequences).
input_type.help_text: 'short-read' and 'long-read' both take a samplesheet with fastq_1/fastq_2 columns and run the full read-processing and variant-calling path (long-read forces the minimap2 aligner and fastplong trimming). 'fasta' takes a samplesheet with a single 'fasta' column (one multi-record FASTA per sample, one record per resistance gene), aligns each record to the reference and diffs it; read-processing parameters are ignored.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

protocol.description: How much of the genome to assess: 'amplicon' (the six resistance genes) or 'wgs' (whole genome).
protocol.help_text: 'amplicon' restricts FreeBayes/LoFreq calling and all report sections to the six CMV resistance genes (faster). 'wgs' runs all callers across the whole genome and shows genome-wide variants plus a whole-genome coverage plot. Either can be used regardless of how the sample was prepared.

run_name.description: A name for this sequencing run, shown at the top of the run-level report.

report_author.description: Name / institute to show as the author of the resistance reports.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome files and options for the workflow.

cmv_ref_fasta.description: CMV reference genome FASTA. Defaults to the bundled Merlin sequence (NC_006273.2).

cmv_ref_gff.description: Annotation for the CMV reference, used to build the snpEff database. Must end in `.gff` (not `.gff3`).

cmv_ref_name.description: Name of the CMV reference sequence. Must match the FASTA header and the annotation seqid.

trimming_host_removal_and_qc_options.title: Trimming, host removal and QC options
trimming_host_removal_and_qc_options.description: Options controlling read trimming, host-read removal and taxonomic classification.

adapter_file.description: Adapter FASTA for Trimmomatic. Required when `--trimmer trimmomatic` is used with short reads.

hostile_index.description: Name of the Hostile reference index to use.

hostile_reference_path.description: Directory containing the Hostile reference / bowtie2 index. Required unless `--skip_host_removal` is set.

kraken2_db.description: Directory containing a Kraken2 database (e.g. the viral database) for taxonomic classification. Required unless `--skip_kraken2` is set.

kraken2_output.description: Also publish the per-read Kraken2 output file (large).

variant_calling_and_alignment_options.title: Variant calling and alignment options
variant_calling_and_alignment_options.description: Options controlling alignment and variant calling.

aligner.description: Read aligner. `bwa-mem3` and `bowtie2` are short-read only.

variant_caller.description: Variant caller(s) to run: `all`, or a comma-separated subset of `ivar`, `freebayes`, `lofreq` (e.g. `ivar,freebayes`).

min_depth.description: Minimum read depth for a position to be assessed for resistance.

min_freq.description: Minimum variant allele frequency to retain a call.
min_freq.help_text: Applied at calling time for iVar and FreeBayes, and by `lofreq filter` for LoFreq.

min_mapq.description: Minimum read mapping quality for variant calling.
min_mapq.help_text: Passed to all three callers (samtools mpileup `-q` for iVar, `--min-mapping-quality` for FreeBayes, `--min-mq` for LoFreq). Set to 0 to disable. Read input only.

include_frameshifts.description: FASTA input only: also call frameshift indels from a consensus alignment. Off by default because Sanger-consensus frameshifts are frequently artefacts.

fasta_min_identity.description: FASTA input only: warn when a consensus record aligns to its declared gene below this identity (records below ~0.7 in both orientations fail).

export_gene_consensus.description: Write a per-gene consensus FASTA per sample to <outdir>/gene_consensus (forward orientation, N-padded to each gene region). Works for both input types.

consensus_ambig_freq.description: FASTQ input only: minor-allele fraction above which the exported gene consensus uses an IUPAC ambiguity code (passed to samtools consensus).

resistance_database_and_report_options.title: Resistance database and report options
resistance_database_and_report_options.description: The CMV resistance / phenotype database and the files used to build the reports.

cmv_resis_db.description: Phenotype database: EC50 ratio and resistance level per mutation/drug.

cmv_resis_db_version.description: Version / date of the phenotype database, shown on the reports.

cmv_genes_bed.description: BED file with the start/end of the six CMV resistance genes (UL27, UL51, UL54, UL56, UL89, UL97), used for the coverage plots. Regenerate with bin/create_resis_genes_bed.py for a non-default reference.

mut_bed.description: BED file with the genomic positions of known resistance mutations, used to mark them on the coverage plots.

bibliography.description: BibTeX file with the references cited in the reports.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. Default is `copy`, which works everywhere; set to `link` (a hard link - zero extra disk space) if `--outdir` is on the same filesystem as the work directory, which is the common case for an HPC scratch area. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

strain_genotyping_options.title: Strain genotyping options
strain_genotyping_options.description: Optional gene-genotype classification (e.g. UL55/gB), independent of resistance-mutation calling. Read input only (short-read/long-read), not FASTA.

genotype_gb.description: Genotype UL55 (glycoprotein B) against a curated gB1-4 reference panel.
genotype_gb.help_text: Builds a consensus over UL55 (independent of --export_gene_consensus) and classifies it by nearest-neighbour percent identity against the reference panel in --gb_genotype_references. Works from either a full-gene (e.g. WGS) or partial (e.g. amplicon) consensus, as long as enough of the informative region is covered - see --genotype_min_compared_bases. Adds one row per sample to <outdir>/genotype/run_genotypes.tsv and a Genotyping section to the sample/run reports.

genotype_gn.description: Genotype UL73 (glycoprotein N) against a curated gN1/gN2/gN3a/gN3b/gN4a/gN4b/gN4c(/gN4d) reference panel.
genotype_gn.help_text: Same mechanism as --genotype_gb (see its help text). Note: the Merlin reference genome's own UL73 sequence is itself an atypical gN4d-lineage sequence rather than a 'central' representative, so genotype calls are made against the curated reference panel in --gn_genotype_references, not by divergence from Merlin.

genotype_genes_bed.description: BED (chrom, start, end, gene) of the gene region(s) to build a genotyping consensus over.

gb_genotype_references.description: FASTA reference panel for gB genotyping - one record per genotype, header = genotype label (e.g. gB1).

gn_genotype_references.description: FASTA reference panel for gN genotyping - one record per genotype, header = genotype label (e.g. gN1, gN3a, gN4b).

genotype_min_region_covered.description: Minimum fraction of the gene with non-N consensus before attempting a call.
genotype_min_region_covered.help_text: This is a sanity floor, not a 'whole gene' requirement - an amplicon assay covering a small, informative fraction of a large gene is expected and fine. --genotype_min_compared_bases is the real quality gate for partial coverage.

genotype_min_compared_bases.description: Minimum informative bases aligned against the best-matching reference to trust an identity score.

genotype_ambiguous_margin.description: Report "ambiguous (X/Y)" rather than a single genotype if the best and second-best identity are within this many percentage points of each other.

genotype_unresolved_floor.description: Report "unresolved" rather than forcing a call if the best identity match is below this percentage.
